note: Hand-labelled by Claude (Sonnet 5.5) by looking at each 768px q60 JPEG, BEFORE any Clef output was run or read. Same rubric as scripts/cam_seaweed.py PROMPT / UW_PROMPT. unreadable=true means the frame is dark, blank or in silhouette; field scoring skips those frames. A dash/null field means not judged. confidence is per field group: low, med or high. Counts of 'people' are estimates (+/-30% on crowds above 20). One label pass, no second reviewer. Frames with set='core' are the 48 stratified frames labelled first. Frames with set='ext' (45) were labelled afterwards, also before reading any per-frame model output: every other frame that has a matched production cam_reads row (28) plus every remaining Spinner frame (17). They exist to give the production-reader check and the Spinner check enough frames.
